changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Intersect]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) not null, [IntersectTypeID] [int] not null, SubjectAssetID bigint null, SubjectAssetTypeID int null, ObjectAssetID bigint null, ObjectAssetTypeID int null, [State] [int] constraint DF_Intersect_State default(1) not null, [CreatedBy] [int] constraint DF_Intersect_CreatedBy default(0) null, [CreatedOn] [datetime] constraint DF_Intersect_CreatedOn default(getutcdate()) null, [UpdatedBy] [int] constraint DF_Intersect_UpdatedBy default(0) null, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] constraint DF_Intersect_UpdatedOn default(getutcdate()) null, [Owner] [varchar](100) null, [Deleted] [bit] constraint DF_Intersect_Deleted default(0) null, [Visible] [bit] constraint DF_Intersect_Visible default(1) not null, [SourceID] [nvarchar](500) null, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] constraint DF_Intersect_uid default(newid()) not null, constraint PK_Intersect primary key clustered ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Intersect_IntersectType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Intersect] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Intersect_IntersectType] FOREIGN KEY([IntersectTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[IntersectType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Intersect] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Intersect_IntersectType] END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetID') begin alter table [dbo].[Intersect] add SubjectAssetID bigint null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [dbo].[Intersect] add SubjectAssetTypeID int null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetID') begin alter table [dbo].[Intersect] add ObjectAssetID bigint null end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Intersect' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [dbo].[Intersect] add ObjectAssetTypeID int null end

alter table [dbo].[Intersect] drop constraint PK_Intersect; alter table [dbo].[Intersect] add constraint [PK_Intersect] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) on [PRIMARY]; end GO if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID') begin drop index [IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID] on [dbo].[Intersect] end GO if exists (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID_Include') begin drop index [IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID_Include] on [dbo].[Intersect] end GO if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID_Include') begin create nonclustered index [IX_Intersect_IntersectTypeID_Include] on [dbo].[Intersect] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC ) include ([UpdatedOn], [ObjectAssetID], [SubjectAssetID]) end GO if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Intersect_Object_IntersectType_Deleted') begin drop index [IX_Intersect_Object_IntersectType_Deleted] on [dbo].[Intersect];
